miqat.title: Your miqat (where to enter ihram)
miqat.fromMadinah: You visit Madinah first, so your miqat is Dhul Hulayfah (Abyar Ali), on the edge of Madinah. Buses and cars can stop at its mosque. The Haramain train does not stop there, so if you take the train, put on ihram in Madinah before boarding and make your intention when the train passes the miqat.
miqat.flyingIn: Your flight passes over this miqat before landing in Jeddah. Wear ihram before boarding or before the crew announces the miqat, and make your intention (niyyah) when it is announced.
miqat.note: General guidance. Please confirm with your scholar or group leader.

ihram.title: Ihram & intention
ihram.body: Before the miqat: take a bath (ghusl), men wear two white unstitched cloths, women wear modest everyday clothes. At the miqat make the intention for Umrah and start reciting the Talbiyah.

guide.talbiyahTranslit: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
guide.talbiyahMeaning: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise, blessings and sovereignty are Yours. You have no partner.

tawaf.title: Tawaf: 7 rounds around the Ka'bah
tawaf.body: Start at the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad), keep the Ka'bah on your left, and walk around it seven times. Tap the button each time you pass the Black Stone.
tawaf.dua: Between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone

sai.title: Sa'i: 7 walks between Safa and Marwah
sai.body: After Tawaf (and two rak'ahs of prayer), go to Safa. Each walk from one hill to the other counts as one round. Round 7 ends at Marwah.

halq.title: Halq or Taqsir
halq.body: Men shave the head (halq) or shorten the hair (taqsir). Women cut a fingertip's length from the end of their hair. Your Umrah is then complete.
